Description: Private version-bound video copies with S3, MediaConvert and a managed Step Functions workflow.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: Boardwalk starts one named Standard workflow per asset version. Native S3 tasks stage an exact source version; Lambda inspects media; MediaConvert sync generates a viewing copy or bounded editor export; Lambda verifies exact output versions and technical metadata. Boardwalk reads terminal results. Optional original-copy jobs run a bounded Fargate task against the pinned source, without staging a full copy; the helper reads its bounded verified receipt.

Copy only an explicit original version to staging/ and write MediaConvert results only to outputs/.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Hold short-lived version-pinned staging copies and durable private browser-ready outputs without exposing either prefix publicly.
must: Keep all four public-access blocks enabled and ACLs disabled.
Allow browser CORS only from https://admin.njpbs.org and only for GET and HEAD.
Expire staging current versions after three days; retain each noncurrent staging version for one day before permanent deletion.
Expire only superseded-tagged noncurrent transcript result versions after seven days; retain referenced transcript results.
Do not expire outputs/ through this stack.
Delete only the exact staging version after output verification succeeds; keep failed attempts for the 3/1-day lifecycle backstop.
com.aws.cloudformation.Context.ops: Deletion/replacement retains the bucket; inventory retained data before any later cleanup.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Reject every cleartext request; same-account role policies provide the only positive access grants.
must: Keep the aws:SecureTransport deny on both bucket and object ARNs.
Do not add a public allow statement.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Isolate Boardwalk preview jobs and cap initial processing to one concurrent job.
must: Keep PricingPlan ON_DEMAND because CloudFormation cannot create reserved queues.
Start at one concurrent job; raise only after a cost and throughput review.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Let only the dedicated MediaConvert queue read staged inputs and write private rendition outputs.
must: Trust MediaConvert only for the exact queue ARN and account.
Read only staging/ and write only outputs/ in the rendition bucket.
Do not grant access to the originals or archive buckets.
